user.description: Enter the IP address of your Rennergy EMS. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the controller.

data.start_address: First register of the item map

modules.title: Select areas
modules.description: Found controller {serial} (firmware {version}) with {count} values. Choose which areas should be added to Home Assistant. You can change this later.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check IP address, port and that Modbus TCP is enabled.
error.no_items: Connected, but no values were found. Use "Auto Address" in the Modbus configuration of the controller.

error.invalid_datasheet: No valid datasheet values found. Format: A7/W35 = 4.8 (one point per line).

schema.title: Plant schema
schema.description: Sensors for the plant schema on the overview page. Flow and return usually come from the heat meter. Empty fields are hidden.

data.hp_flow_temp: Flow temperature (also used for the lift)

data.tank_sensors: Temperature sensors from top to bottom

heat_pump.title: Heat pump
heat_pump.description:
Factor = performance factor × lift (flow − outdoor temperature). For the target factor enter the COP values of the datasheet, one point per line, e.g.:
A-7/W35 = 2.9
A2/W35 = 3.8
A7/W35 = 4.8
A7/W55 = 3.0
Values in between are interpolated.

data.hp_running_w: Heat pump runs above electric power

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: Choose Home Assistant sensors used for the statistics. Please select the cumulative total counters, not daily or monthly ones. Day, week, month and year values are calculated from the long-term statistics. Empty fields are not used.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: The "Hot water quick load" button switches the selected item to manual/on for the given duration and back to automatic afterwards. Without a selection the item with "Schnelladung" in its name is used.

data.hot_water_item: Item for hot water quick load
